settings.schema: Busy card stays, the answer arrives as its own message.
The answer replaces the busy card's body in place.
The busy card is replaced by the answer alone.
File edits show only as rows on the busy card.
On - a diff message per edit
Each Write/Edit is also posted as its own diff message under the busy card.
On - slow down as a turn gets long
The card refreshes less often as a turn runs on (every 10 s after 2 min, every 30 s after 10 min) and its clock then moves in 30 s steps, so it never looks frozen. A state change still shows at once.
Off - same pace for the whole turn
The card refreshes at the same pace for the whole turn, however long.
Claude formats replies however it likes.
Plain prose and dashed lists only - no tables or code blocks.

settings.sections:
🖼 Message layout

How a finished turn appears in the chat.

📝 Diff previews

Whether each file edit is posted as a separate diff message under the busy card. Off keeps one busy card and one answer - the card still lists every edit, and the Mini App has a diff viewer.
On - a diff message per edit

⏱ Long-turn card updates

How often a busy card refreshes during a LONG turn. On, it slows down as the turn gets older and its clock moves in 30 s steps, which keeps a long-running chat well inside Telegram's limits. Off keeps the first-minutes pace for the whole turn.
On - slow down as a turn gets long ✅
Off - same pace for the whole turn

✏️ Simple formatting

When ON, replies use plain prose and simple dashed lists only - no tables, code blocks, headings, or bold/italics.

📏 Answer length

How long Claude's replies should be.
